unknowns: Emboss trong Print Effects: không tìm thấy ở surface nào đã kiểm; chưa biết nó bị gate bởi plan, bởi layer type, hay bởi cấu hình 3rd-party service
Menu "..." trên layer action bar mà brief giả định: không tồn tại trong build này
Icon chain 🔗 cho linked layer: không quan sát thấy trên layer row
Delete / Change position của template: không có trong menu ... (chỉ có Convert to Global Template)
Validation rule đầy đủ của 8 layer type bị chặn save — mới có 1 sample mỗi loại nên confidence LOW, không suy ra required/boundary

observations.surface: Artwork editor
observations.observed_result: Popup .add-layer-popup lists 29 items in 7 groups (TEXT/IMAGE/VECTOR/MAPS & ASTRONOMY/PUZZLES/OTHERS/FORM ELEMENTS); 6 items expand into submenus giving 35 distinct layer types total.

observations.surface: Artwork editor
observations.observed_result: Every editable layer row exposes exactly 5 icon buttons: la-eye, la-unlock, la-pen, la-copy, la-trash-alt.

observations.surface: Artwork editor
observations.observed_result: Bar is identical for 1, 2 and 3 selected layers: Deselect / N selected / Group (Ctrl/Cmd+G) / Ungroup (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+G) [disabled] / Copy to clipboard / Duplicate / Duplicate & Link options / Delete. No "..." overflow button exists in this build.

observations.surface: Artwork editor
observations.observed_result: Toolbar content varies with selected layer types: text -> Transform/Align/Print Effects/font+size; image -> Transform/Align/Print Effects; form elements (color,toggle) -> Align only.

observations.surface: Artwork editor
observations.observed_result: Popover .qfield-container.sc-layout-screen offers shape-cut presets 1x2, 1x3, 1x4, 2x1, 2x3 plus Customize (custom rows/columns grid, Apply layout disabled at 0 shape cut). Footnote: "Effect layers only appear on Order Design as production guides for your print provider."

observations.surface: Artwork editor
observations.observed_result: No element or text matching /emboss/i found anywhere in the page while Print Effects was open, for text, image, vector and word-cloud layers. No 3rd-party dependency text observed in the popover.

observations.surface: Artwork editor
observations.observed_result: Linked copy is identified by its config panel collapsing to two accordions LINKED LAYER + EXTRA with text "This layer is linked to another layer. Design and personalization are synced from it. Source layer: <name>". No chain icon appears on the layer row.

observations.surface: Artwork editor
observations.observed_result: la-caret-down (template list), la-cog (Template Settings modal), la-plus (menu: Add new / Import from artwork), btn-set-invisible--disabled (hide/show, disabled with a single template), la-pencil-alt (Edit - <template> modal: Name / Thumbnail / Browse / Extra charge for this template), la-copy (duplicates immediately, no dialog), button.alab-action__more (single item: Convert to Global Template).

observations.surface: Artwork editor
observations.observed_result: On /artworks each .artwork-item has la-search-plus, la-pencil, la-copy and la-ellipsis-h; the ellipsis menu contains: Import to Translation / Mark as archive / Delete artwork. Delete confirms with "Are you sure to remove <name>?" and buttons Remove / Cancel.

observations.surface: Artwork editor
observations.observed_result: /extras/extra-services has tabs Maps, Gen AI Effects, Remove Background, Cutout.Pro, ImagenHub, Upload limit settings, Canva. Gen AI Effects offers a default AI service choice: OpenAI (GPT) Image / Flux Kontext / Gemini.

observations.surface: Artwork editor
observations.observed_result: Adding, configuring, duplicating and deleting layers produce zero API calls. The artwork is written only on Save & Close (POST /api/artworks -> 201).

observations.surface: Artwork editor
observations.observed_result: Save & Close with all 35 layer types is blocked client-side; 8 layer types require extra configuration before an artwork can be saved.

observations.surface: Artwork editor
observations.observed_result: Vector picker showed "Empty data"; no VECTOR layer type can be added until at least one vector asset exists in the library.
